gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-lao: Tall, tight and urban, Capture It looks nearly sealed shut. Noto Sans Lao is the real surprise, a sans whose lowercase rises well above the usual while its mouths stay open on c, e and a.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-lao-l: Capture It draws every round bowl as a smooth, unswelling outline. Noto Sans Lao Looped adds a plain sans whose words form solid blocks, with bowls left unfinished on one side, which makes the whole pair feel sturdy and modern.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-lepch: Capture It towers over its line with a huge x-height and letters that look almost sealed shut, with no thick-thin flicker. Noto Sans Lepcha is the open one, its curves wide and its lowercase standing like cast iron capitals.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Commanding and urban, Capture It packs its tall letters tightly, barely leaving an opening anywhere. And Noto Sans Limbu lets its curves gape wide, with tall-bodied small letters that feel friendly and approachable.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-lydia: Capture It looks like neon tubing, one steady line glowing at a towering x-height with openings nearly sealed. But shrink the heading, and Noto Sans Lydian, with capitals barely taller than lowercase and wide-sprung curves, quickly takes over.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-mahaj: Noto Sans Mahajani stands its lowercase tall against the capitals, with a wide funnel-like throat in the e that feels modern and open. Capture It, bent like thin plastic tubing, stays tightly closed beside it.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-malay: Commanding and urban, Capture It bends like copper pipe. Noto Sans Malayalam feels much looser beside it, with a dominant middle zone and an s whose bends stay generously open.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-manda: Noto Sans Mandaic reads as loose and curvy, its lowercase rising near the capitals. Capture It, closed up and towering, would suit larger sizes, while this body stays comfortable smaller.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-march: Noto Sans Marchen has small letters standing proud, nearly capital-sized, with curves ending in clear daylight. Capture It keeps its strokes uniform and tightly closed, so give it more size.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-mayan: Capture It is all tall, tubular urban muscle, with no thick-thin modulation and barely any opening in its letters. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals answers with tall-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c, so the closed and open shapes trade off nicely.
